Minimum.$description: Smallest tappable size for any control, per Apple HIG and WCAG 2.5.5. Applied to the hit area, which may extend beyond the painted box, so a control can stay visually small while remaining operable.

12.$description: voiceCircle's outer halo ring. Percent steps follow the color.alpha.* primitives already in this file.

surface.$description: Elevated container fill, used for cards, bottom sheets, modals, dropdown menus, chat bubbles, toasts.

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent overlay dimming content behind a modal, used behind modals, dialogs, and bottom sheets.

floating.$description: Elevated floating surface with translucency, used for dropdown menus, tooltips, popovers that float above content with a frosted-glass effect.

stacking.$description: Additive white layer for stacking elevation on dark surfaces, used for toasts, snackbars, floating notifications that need subtle lift above dark backgrounds.

input.$description: Fill of an editable field, used for text inputs, textareas, search fields at rest.

page.$description: Root screen canvas, used for every screen's base background.

inverse.$description: Dark block on a light screen, used for tooltips, toasts, snackbars on light backgrounds.

primary.$description: Main call-to-action fill, used for 'Continue,' 'Check,' 'Start practice' buttons, progress bar fills. One primary CTA per screen.

destructive.$description: Irreversible harmful action fill, used for delete, remove, block buttons.

onPrimary.$description: Label text and icons placed on top of interactive.primary fills, required to hold at least 4.5:1 contrast.

pressOverlay.$description: Press overlay for light or vivid surfaces, used for tap feedback on primary buttons and elements sitting on accent fills.

pressOverlayInverse.$description: Press overlay for dark surfaces, used for tap feedback on secondary buttons, icon buttons, list items and cards on background.page or background.surface.

primaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.primary, used for pointer hover on primary buttons.

primaryActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.primary, used for the moment of click or tap on a primary button.

secondaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.secondary, used for pointer hover on secondary buttons, chips and toggles.

secondaryActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.secondary, used for the moment of press on a secondary button.

destructiveHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.destructive, used for pointer hover on delete and remove buttons.

destructiveActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.destructive, used for the moment of press on a destructive button.

onDestructive.$description: Label text and icons placed on top of interactive.destructive fills, required to hold at least 4.5:1 contrast.

secondary.$description: Supporting action fill, used for 'Skip,' 'Cancel,' filter chips, outlined buttons, toggles.

disabled.$description: Non-interactive control fill signaling 'unavailable.' Dark scrim rather than a light wash, so it reads as 'off' regardless of the base color underneath instead of coinciding with interactive.secondary's resting value, used for disabled buttons, toggles, sliders.

onSecondary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.secondary fills, used for labels inside secondary buttons, toggle text, filter chip labels.

secondary.$description: Reduced emphasis text for supporting content, used for subtitles, captions, timestamps, helper text, metadata.

inverse.$description: Dark text on light or vivid surfaces, used for labels on background.inverse, text on bright accent fills.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink text only, used for linked text in body copy, T&C links, 'Learn more' inline links.

disabled.$description: Low-contrast text signaling an unavailable control. Used on disabled controls only, which WCAG 1.4.3 exempts from contrast. Not for placeholder text — an empty field's placeholder is normal text and must hold 4.5:1; use text.secondary there.

tertiary.$description: Lowest emphasis readable text, used for timestamps, counts, inline hints beside a field.

success.$description: Confirmation text, used for "Correct", validation success messages.

error.$description: Validation message text, used for the line under a failed field.

warning.$description: Caution text, used for limits, expiry notices, "one attempt left".

onAccent.$description: Label text and icons placed directly on any accent.*.bold fill, required to hold at least 4.5:1 contrast against the accent underneath.

primary.$description: Highest contrast text for maximum readability, used for headlines, body copy, titles, card labels. Default when unsure which text token to pick.

linkHover.$description: Hover state of text.link, used for pointer hover on inline hyperlinks.

default.$description: Standard container edge, used for card outlines, dividers, input borders at rest, separators.

strong.$description: Higher contrast container edge, used for dividers that must read at a glance, table rules, edges on busy surfaces.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring, used as the visible focus indicator on any focusable element and always paired with a 2px Stroke/Heavy Border.

error.$description: Invalid input edge, used for text fields and selects that failed validation.

success.$description: Validated input edge, used for fields confirmed correct.

selected.$description: Edge of a chosen element, used for selected cards, active tabs, chosen answer options.

bold.$description: Solid PRO fill, used for PRO badges, upgrade banners.

onBold.$description: Text and icons placed on top of pro.bold fills.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis PRO fill, used for tinted background behind a PRO hint or soft upsell.

accent.$description: Legacy alias of pro.bold kept only for older descriptions that still reference the old name, used for PRO badges and upgrade prompts.

bold.$description: Solid brand violet fill, used for brand moments, onboarding hero panels.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis brand fill, used for tinted brand panels.

bold.$description: Solid coral accent fill, used for decorative emphasis, category tags, illustration accents.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis coral fill, used for tinted background behind a coral tag or illustration accent.

bold.$description: Solid magenta accent fill, used for decorative category tags.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis magenta fill, used for tinted background behind a magenta tag.

bold.$description: Solid blue accent fill, used for informational chips, secondary category tags.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis blue fill, used for tinted background behind a blue chip or tag.

bold.$description: Solid green accent fill, used for streak counters, progress markers, positive stat chips.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis green fill, used for tinted background behind a green stat or chip.

eyes.$description: Homie eye whites, used for mascot illustration only.

pupils.$description: Homie pupils, used for mascot illustration only.

primary.$description: Mascot signature violet, a character color rather than a UI one, used for mascot illustration fill, tip banners where the mascot is present, full-screen backgrounds for mascot-hero moments like onboarding and celebration.

bold.$description: Solid success fill, used for correct answer banners, completion states.

subtle.$description: Tinted success background, used for the panel behind a correct result.

bold.$description: Solid error fill, used for incorrect answer banners, failed validation summaries.

subtle.$description: Tinted error background, used for the panel behind a wrong result.

onSubtle.$description: Text and icons on feedback.warning.subtle fills.

bold.$description: Solid warning fill, used for caution banners, limit-reached summaries.

onBold.$description: Label text and icons placed on top of feedback.warning.bold fills, required to hold at least 4.5:1 contrast.

subtle.$description: Soft warning surface, used for caution banners, expiry notices at rest.

surface.$description: Fill of a chosen element, used for selected cards, active tabs, the answer a student picked.

border.$description: Edge of a chosen element on a highlight.surface fill, always used paired with highlight.surface and never alone.

displayL.$description: Text style "Greed/Display L" from the file's type scale.

displayM.$description: Text style "Greed/Display M" from the file's type scale.

displayS.$description: Text style "Greed/Display S" from the file's type scale.

headlineXl.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline XL" from the file's type scale.

headlineL.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline L" from the file's type scale.

headlineM.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline M" from the file's type scale.

headlineS.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline S" from the file's type scale.

headlineXsBold.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline XS Bold" from the file's type scale.

headlineXsRegular.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline XS Regular" from the file's type scale.

headlineXxsBold.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline XXS Bold" from the file's type scale.

headlineXxsRegular.$description: Text style "Greed/Headline XXS Regular" from the file's type scale.

bodyMBold.$description: Text style "Greed/Body M Bold" from the file's type scale.

bodyMRegular.$description: Text style "Greed/Body M Regular" from the file's type scale.

bodySBold.$description: Text style "Greed/Body S Bold" from the file's type scale.

bodySRegular.$description: Text style "Greed/Body S Regular" from the file's type scale.

captionMBold.$description: Text style "Greed/Caption M Bold" from the file's type scale.

captionMRegular.$description: Text style "Greed/Caption M Regular" from the file's type scale.

captionSBold.$description: Text style "Greed/Caption S Bold" from the file's type scale.

captionSRegular.$description: Text style "Greed/Caption S Regular" from the file's type scale.
